posts.title: Fake *county invoice* payment SMS
posts.sms: Dear supplier, your pending bill voucher has been approved. Pay Sh4,500 clearance fee to release your Sh380,000 cheque.
tips: No county government asks for cash to process vouchers.
Check all money owed to suppliers on county portals.
Report fake county clearance notices to the DCI.
posts.message: Scammers target county suppliers with fake clearance fee demands for money owed to suppliers.
posts.action: Report suspicious procurement texts to the DCI hotline on 0800722203
posts.caption:
No government office asks you to pay money to receive your payment. Verify your voucher status in person at the county treasury.

#Usiibiwe #KenyaOnRecord
beats: Scammers are targeting small traders with *fake county payment* alerts.
They demand cash before releasing your approved voucher.
No county department charges a fee to clear cheques.
Kenyans demand: county governments publish supplier lists.
Verify your payment status at your county treasury.

scripts.radio:
Sasa, na karibu kwa Kenya on Record. Mimi ni sauti yako ya uwajibikaji.

Wiki hii, tunaanza na tahadhari kali kutoka kwa dawati letu la Usiibiwe. Wasanii wa ulaghai wamelenga wauzaji na watoaji huduma wa kaunti, wakiwataka walipe karo za usafi au clearance fees ndiposa walipwe pesa zao za pending bills. Hiyo ni mitego! Hakuna afisa wa kaunti anayepaswa kukuomba rushwa ndogo ili akushughulikie malipo.

Upande wa maendeleo, Lake Nakuru inaendelea kung'aa kama moja ya hifadhi za wanyamapika na vifaru yenye mafanikio makubwa nchini. Vile vile, Olkaria inazalisha asilimia arobaini ya umeme wa Kenya kupitia mvuke wa ardhini—ushahidi tosha wa uwezo wetu wa kinyumbani.

Lakini katika Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia, wananchi wanasherehekea bajeti kubwa ya maendeleo, lakini bado wanalalamikia kuchelewa kwa miradi ya afya. Hali iko hivyo pia katika vyuo vikuu vyetu, ambapo watafiti wanaendelea kuchapisha tafiti za kiwango cha kimataifa kwenye uhandisi.

Kwenye mitandao, mnauliza: Je, kupunguzwa kwa ushuru wa mafuta au kupunguza matumizi ya serikali kutaleta nafuu ya haraka? Na je, sheria hizo mpya za ushuru zitapunguza gharama ya maisha? Endelea kufuatilia Kenya on Record kwa ukweli mtupu.

*Ufupi kwa Kiswahili:* Wiki hii tunaangazia ulaghai wa pending bills za kaunti, mafanikio ya Olkaria na Lake Nakuru, kuchelewa kwa miradi ya afya Trans Nzoia, na mjadala mkali kuhusu kodi na gharama ya maisha.
scripts.voice_note: Sasa wakuu, hapa ndipo Kenya on Record. Sikilizeni kwa makini: Wajanja wanalenga watoaji huduma wa kaunti na stori za fake clearance fees za pending bills. Eti ulipe ndiposa upate pesa zako! Hiyo ni scam tupu, msikubali kutapeliwa. Kwingineko, Olkaria inatupa asilimia arobaini ya umeme wetu, wakati Lake Nakuru inatamba kama hifadhi bora ya vifaru. Lakini kule Trans Nzoia, bado kuna kiza fulani kwa miradi ya afya licha ya bajeti nzuri ya maendeleo. Na kwenye vichochoro vya mijadala, mnasema nini kuhusu hizi sheria mpya za kodi na bei ya mafuta? Je, zitaleta nafuu au ni porojo? Tupeni maoni yenu, na kumbuka—usiibiwe!
scripts.sms: USIIBIWE: Machalari wanalenga watoaji huduma wa kaunti na fake clearance fees eti ndiposa walipwe pending bills. Hakuna malipo ya aina hiyo. Kuwa mwangalifu!
scripts.reels: Wajanja wamebadilisha mbinu! Sasa hivi wanalenga watoaji huduma wa kaunti na madai bandia ya 'clearance fees' ndiposa ulipwe pending bills zako. Hiyo ni mitego ya wazi kabisa! Usiibiwe pesa zako kwa sababu ya njaa ya matapeli. Ingia Kenya on Record ujue mengi!
